verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents simultaneous multi-user editing, live cursors, or real-time sync in Penpot. The pricing line "Collaborate freely with unlimited teams" is about team and account limits, not live co-editing, so it is only adjacent and earns no credit. Real-time multiplayer is a fair axis for a design tool, so the verdict is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a designer, my whole team can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync
